Proposition
[Completeness criterion for foliations] 1. Proposition 4.8.1\group foliations Source: thurston:page-0074, thurston:page-0075 If the transverse group $J$ is transitive and its isotropy groups are compact, the developing map of a differentiable $-foliation on a closed manifold is a fibration.

Proof

\sketch Choose a transverse plane field and invariant transverse metric. Horizontal lifts have uniformly controlled length, hence extend globally by completeness of the universal cover. Lifting radial disks supplies local trivializations.

□
